payload.description_html: • Scale diagram of the largest known dinosaurs (length and mass) of four suborders: Sauropodomorpha (Maraapunisaurus fragillimus), Cerapoda (Magnapaulia laticaudus), Theropoda (Spinosaurus aegyptiacus), and Thyreophora (Stegosaurus stenops). Compared in size with a human. Each grid section represents 1 square meter. *Adapted from illustrations and scale diagrams by ArthurWeasley, Steveoc 86, Dropzink, and Piotr Jaworski
